import re
import sys


def main():
    n = int(sys.argv[1])

    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    original_length = len(data)
    sequence = re.sub(rb">.*\n|\n", b"", data)
    stripped_length = len(sequence)
    del data

    patterns = (
        b"agggtaaa|tttaccct",
        b"[cgt]gggtaaa|tttaccc[acg]",
        b"a[act]ggtaaa|tttacc[agt]t",
        b"ag[act]gtaaa|tttac[agt]ct",
        b"agg[act]taaa|ttta[agt]cct",
        b"aggg[acg]aaa|ttt[cgt]ccct",
        b"agggt[cgt]aa|tt[acg]accct",
        b"agggta[cgt]a|t[acg]taccct",
        b"agggtaa[cgt]|[acg]ttaccct",
    )

    output = [
        f"{pattern.decode('ascii')} {len(re.findall(pattern, sequence))}"
        for pattern in patterns
    ]

    substitutions = (
        (rb"tHa[Nt]", b"<4>"),
        (rb"aND|caN|Ha[DS]|WaS", b"<3>"),
        (rb"a[NSt]|BY", b"<2>"),
        (rb"<[^>]*>", b"|"),
        (rb"\|[^|][^|]*\|", b"-"),
    )

    for pattern, replacement in substitutions:
        sequence = re.sub(pattern, replacement, sequence)

    output.extend((
        "",
        str(original_length),
        str(stripped_length),
        str(len(sequence)),
    ))
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(output) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
